name: Source Ingestion & Raw Artifact Engine
boundary_note: 원문·수집 상태를 Evidence로 제공. HTTP/parse 성공 자체가 Event가 아님.

name: Canonical Object Identity Engine
boundary_note: canonical identity/alias context. 이름·ID 자체로 사건/신뢰도 판단 금지.

name: Evidence & Provenance Engine
boundary_note: provenance/source grade가 E39/E43의 근거가 되지만 독립 Event 생성 금지.

name: Universal Space Time Engine
boundary_note: 시간축/epoch/replay context만 제공. 과학 중요도 판단 금지.

name: Coordinate & Reference Frame Engine
boundary_note: 좌표/프레임 변환 context. 변환 품질은 uncertainty 입력이 될 수 있으나 사건 생성 금지.

name: Digital State / Snapshot / Version Engine
boundary_note: snapshot/version lineage가 Revision 비교의 기준. 자체로 Event를 생성하지 않음.

name: Space Knowledge Graph & Archive Engine
boundary_note: Mission/Object/Event 관계 context. 관계 provenance는 설명 근거가 될 수 있음.

name: Solar System Ephemeris Engine
boundary_note: 천체 상태/ephemeris 변화는 E09 등의 사건 계산에 직접 입력. 단순 위치 갱신은 Signal Gate 통과 전 Event 아님.

name: Celestial Event Engine
boundary_note: eclipse/opposition/close approach 등 의미 있는 천체 사건 후보를 생성 가능.

name: Solar / Space Weather Context Engine
boundary_note: 태양/우주기상 context 변화가 Event/Orbit context Revision을 구동 가능.

name: NEO / Small Body Tracking Engine
boundary_note: NEO/small-body tracking의 close-approach/trajectory 변화가 Event 후보가 될 수 있음.

name: Deep-Space Mission Tracking Engine
boundary_note: deep-space mission tracking 상태/encounter 변화가 Mission Event Revision을 구동.

name: Mission Registry Engine
boundary_note: Mission identity/metadata registry. 일정/상태 사건은 E14/E15가 생성.

name: Launch Schedule / Window Engine
boundary_note: 공식 launch window/schedule 변경이 Mission Event Revision을 생성.

name: Launch State Machine & Countdown Engine
boundary_note: COUNTDOWN/LIFTOFF/ASCENT 등 mission state transition이 Event를 생성/갱신.

name: Telemetry Fusion Engine
boundary_note: 실제 telemetry/official feed 변화가 Mission Event와 confidence/uncertainty에 직접 입력.

name: Launch Trajectory / Flight Dynamics Adapter Engine
boundary_note: derived/modelled trajectory 차이/flight-dynamics signal을 제공. telemetry와 EvidenceClass 분리 필수.

name: Mission Timeline & Recorder Engine
boundary_note: mission timeline/record를 불변 기록하여 Revision/Replay 근거 제공. 자체 판단 금지.

name: Mission Replay & Mission-to-Orbit Handover Engine
boundary_note: Replay 및 Mission→Orbit 객체 handover의 lineage/context. Replay가 현재 Event를 생성하면 실패.

name: Orbit Propagation & Frames Engine
boundary_note: orbit state/residual/change signal을 제공. 단순 periodic update는 Signal Gate 전 Event 금지.

name: Conjunction Screening & Precise TCA Engine
boundary_note: screening/TCA 결과는 conjunction Event 후보/Revision의 직접 입력.

name: Collision Probability & Risk Provenance Engine
boundary_note: Pc/MaxP/risk provenance를 metric별 Signal로 제공. covariance 없는 Pc 생성 금지.

name: Risk Graph Engine
boundary_note: metric-specific risk edge/graph delta가 Event 및 scenario 판단에 직접 입력.

name: Orbital Environment / Congestion Engine
boundary_note: shell congestion/activity/re-entry context의 유의 변화가 환경 Event 후보가 될 수 있음.

name: Debris Genealogy / Origin Engine
boundary_note: debris origin/genealogy context. 새로운 proven fragmentation relation은 Evidence가 될 수 있으나 자동 위험 Event 생성 금지.

name: Fragmentation Scenario Engine
boundary_note: 명시적 SIMULATION_ONLY fragmentation scenario. Intelligence/사용자 요청으로 실행; 관측 사실로 승격 금지.

name: Re-entry Intelligence Engine
boundary_note: re-entry watch/prediction revision이 Event/Revision 직접 입력. grade/window 보존.

name: Photometry / Rotation Intelligence Engine
boundary_note: photometry/rotation estimate 및 anomaly signal. estimated label/uncertainty 필수.

name: Observation Planning Engine
boundary_note: Evidence gap/low-confidence Event에 대해 Intelligence가 관측계획 계산을 요청.

name: Citizen Observation QA & Contribution Engine
boundary_note: QA ACCEPTED 관측만 새 Evidence로 재계산을 촉발. 제출 자체는 Event가 아님.

name: Intervention Benefit / Counterfactual Engine
boundary_note: Baseline/Counterfactual Benefit 계산 도구. 결과는 ATTRIBUTION_RESULT/SIMULATION이며 observed Event가 아님.

name: Affected Subgraph Engine
boundary_note: E31/E33의 선택적 재계산 최적화. Intelligence에 직접 결과 승격 금지; equivalence 검증 필수.

name: PROTECT Reverse Query & Candidate OCM Comparison Engine
boundary_note: PROTECT/OCM decision comparison 도구. 자동 명령/공식 추천으로 승격 금지.

name: Multi-Scale Space Scene Engine
boundary_note: 멀티스케일 3D 표현. Intelligence/과학 결과를 변경할 권한 없음.

name: Semantic Zoom / Camera Focus Engine
boundary_note: Semantic zoom/camera focus. 카메라/LOD가 계산 subset을 변경하면 실패.

name: Orbital Shell & LOD Engine
boundary_note: LEO/MEO/GEO shell/LOD 표현. shell 시각값이 risk/confidence를 생성하면 실패.

name: Visual Semantics Engine
boundary_note: Reality/Model/Simulation/Uncertainty 시각 문법을 소비. presentation only.

name: Aetherus Intelligence Orchestrator
boundary_note: 실행 그래프 총괄. 과학값 자체 생성 금지.

name: Evidence Fusion & Cross Validation Intelligence
boundary_note: Evidence fusion/cross-validation. source conflict/coverage를 구조화.

name: Signal Classification Intelligence
boundary_note: Signal/EvidenceClass 분류와 promotion gate.

name: Event Intelligence Engine
boundary_note: Event correlation/new-vs-existing 결정.

name: Revision Intelligence Engine
boundary_note: Revision delta/history 관리. 과거 revision 삭제 금지.

name: Confidence & Uncertainty Intelligence Engine
boundary_note: Confidence와 Uncertainty를 분리 산출/표현.

name: Importance / Why-It-Matters / Attribution & Decision Intelligence Engine
boundary_note: Importance/Why-it-matters/Attribution/Decision을 구조화. command/법적 결론 금지.
